source: ComicsBox USA series indexes, ComicsBox issue character credits, and existing MarvelTracker paths
rules: Dedicated and co-billed series are followed issue by issue using their first verified Italian publication.
Configured issue selectors are used for anthology or mantle-sharing series; unselected issues are excluded.
Shared history is reused only when the character is credited among the protagonists of a USA story already represented by an existing MarvelTracker path.
Simple appearances/cameos are excluded from shared-history reuse.
A physical Italian issue keeps its existing global ownership ID; reading progress remains path-local through readingStep.contentIds.
Missing or invalid source series are audited and never replaced with invented Italian editions.
Punisher MAX, Noir and other non-616 continuities are excluded from the Frank Castle Terra-616 path.
